# nsDeploy reference core

Source: Cognizant AI Lab nsDeploy, pinned at 486ecf26aa8775963f9b765f894734bef1ac9817.

These selected reference-runtime and generated-kernel modules are redistributed unchanged under the accompanying Apache-2.0 license. Preserve upstream copyright and generated-source headers. The optional LangChain bundle, engine UI, remote-code sandbox and provider client are not included. SUTRA implements its restricted host adapter separately; this is not an official nsDeploy release.
